original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 updates the image-automation-controller component image to v1.0.1; environments referencing that image are updated to the new version on upgrade, and the release notes state no required action.

decision.reason: [ev-8c9f143ab334] only says Flux 2.7.0 updates the image-automation-controller component to v1.0.1. Any environment that runs that component gets the new version, so image-in-use{image-automation-controller} matches the canonical exposure shape for an image version change. The evidence gives the name only as "image-automation-controller" and never names a full registry repository, so adding one would be a guess. The evidence also says nothing about what changed inside v1.0.1, so exposure here means only that these environments receive the version bump.
